ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white ventral surface (approx. 75-80%) contrasted against low-intensity black margins and internal focal markings (approx. 20-25%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white central fields dominate both lobes. Low-intensity black forms a continuous peripheral band. A distinct, isolated low-intensity circular pixel cluster is located on the distal-medial region of the left lobe. Vertical low-intensity streaks are concentrated around the central notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped notch with an internal angle of approximately 72 degrees, showing sharp convergence at the peduncle interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrations along the entire trailing edge. Right lobe displays greater peak-to-valley pixel amplitude than the left lobe, with distinct jagged protrusions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a linear-to-convex sweep tapering to an acute lateral tip; right lobe exhibits a more pronounced convex curve ending in a blunt, heavily encrusted tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-relief clusters of high-contrast white/tan pixel groups (barnacles) localized on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes. Multiple small, isolated low-intensity circular spots (pigment or scars) scattered across the high-intensity fields.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, thin, unaligned low-intensity linear marking oriented diagonally across the left lobe. Multiple vertical low-intensity linear striations are visible originating from the fluke-peduncle junction.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant topographic alteration of the distal margins due to extensive barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema), particularly on the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'eye-spot' or ocellus-like circular black marking on the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe's ventral surface.
